recentItems.title: US Treasury Mints Special 9/11 Tribute Coins
recentItems.description:
The U.S. Department of the Treasury has created a special half dollar to be given to the families of 9/11 victims. The coin features the Statue of Liberty and the inscription “Always Remember 9-11-01” as well as a “W” to represent West Point, where the coins were minted by New Yorkers. They will be distributed around the nation.

recentItems.title: Rodrigo Santoro on New Film 'Runner' and Most-Recognized Role
recentItems.description:
Actor Rodrigo Santoro joins TODAY to talk about his new action-thriller, “Runner,” and shares details about his complicated character. Saying, “It’s not the typical villain, it’s very three-dimensional,” adding, “This is a troubled guy…it’s important to humanize every character you play.” He also shares the importance of first responders in the movie and reveals the role he is most recognized for.

recentItems.title: Gary Sinise on Helping Tell the Story of 9/11 in New Documentary
recentItems.description:
Actor and humanitarian Gary Sinise has dedicated his life to helping our nation's veterans and first responders. Now he's highlighting incredible acts of courage and compassion of Sept. 11 that continue to inspire 25 years later, as the narrator of a new documentary called "The Heroism and Resiliency of 9/11: From Tragedy to Triumph." "It really shows the heroism of so many people who stepped up on that day and then what happened afterwards as people kind of took up the charge," he says, adding, "Service can be a great healer for a broken heart."

recentItems.title: Son of 9/11 Victim Honors Mother's Legacy With New Book
recentItems.description:
Elizabeth Holmes was a single mother working at the World Trade Center when the unthinkable happened on 9/11. Her son, Reverend Travis Boyd, is now preserving her legacy with his book “The Purse She Left Behind.” He talks about the significance of her purse, his relationship with Reverend Al Sharpton, and how he has dealt with the immeasurable loss. “My story isn’t defined by tragedy, it’s defined by the vision my mother had for me,” he says.

recentItems.title: New Doc Gives Inside Look at Windows on the World Restaurant
recentItems.description:
"Top of the World," is a new documentary shining a light on the untold story of Windows on the World, the legendary restaurant that sat atop the World Trade Center where the staff built an extraordinary sort of family. Executive producer Katie Lee Biegel, and chef Michael Lomonaco who survived the attacks of Sept. 11, join TODAY to discuss the project.

recentItems.title: 9/11 Hero Posthumously Awarded Medal of Freedom
recentItems.description:
Welles Crowther could've escaped the World Trade Center on 9/11. Instead, he ran back repeatedly, saving two dozen people before dying in the building collapse. Now, on the 25th anniversary of the attacks, Crowther is posthumously being awarded the Presidential Medal of Freedom. NBC's Aaron Gilchrist reports for TODAY.
